target.title: fix(telegram): harden rich send fallback and typing breaker
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes the remaining Telegram runtime behaviors from #99471:

- Raise the default typing-start breaker from 2 to 5 consecutive failures so transient `sendChatAction` failures do not silence typing feedback too aggressively.
- Treat `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` like the existing Telegram rich-message validation failures and fall back to plain text when there is sendable fallback text.
- Guard empty rendered rich-message payloads before `sendRichMessage`, and let chunked durable delivery skip unsendable empty rich chunks instead of aborting later valid chunks.

The rich-message reply-context text extraction portion of #99471 is already present on current `main`; this branch is based on current `main` and leaves that existing fix intact.

Closes #99471

## Implementation notes

- `src/channels/typing.ts` now uses a named default of 5 consecutive failures while preserving explicit overrides and existing success-reset behavior.
- `extensions/telegram/src/send-error-predicates.ts` now shares a rich-message plain-text fallback predicate for invalid rich entities and `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`.
- Both Telegram send funnels are kept aligned:
  - `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts`
  - `extensions/telegram/src/send.ts`
- Regression tests cover:
  - default typing breaker trips after five failures, not two;
  - durable rich send falls back on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`;
  - delivery rich send falls back on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`;
  - empty rich text is rejected before calling Telegram's raw `sendRichMessage`.

## Validation

Local lightweight prechecks:

- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/channels/typing.ts src/channels/typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/send-error-predicates.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check -- src/channels/typing.ts src/channels/typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/send-error-predicates.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` — passed

CI is expected to provide the full targeted test/build signal for this PR.

## Risk

Low to moderate:

- Typing feedback may continue retrying longer during transient channel typing failures, but still stops after a bounded number of consecutive failures.
- Rich-message fallback only catches Telegram validation/content-required errors; other send failures still propagate.
- Empty rich chunks without sendable plain text are skipped in the durable chunk loop to preserve later valid chunks.
